notes.title: Major update September 29th!
notes.notes:
First off I would like to thank all the early supporters and players! We appreciate all of your feedback.  

Our first major update includes essential features, overall polish, and much more! 


Features

Arena mode asynchronous game mode.

New items.

Ability changes. 

Premade pack updates.

Entire UI/UX Overhaul.

Friendly battles now can use any pack.

Basic gameplay Tutorial.

View opponent's team. (Can now view last round opponent's team).

Temporary Ranked ban system for abusing game abandonment for gaining ranked rating.

Many more essential UI/UX features for clarity to gameplay.


Core changes

XP orbs are no longer free at the beginning of each round. 
Instead are a normal Tier 2 item. 
In preparation for the (Arena mode) launch this was a essential change as power creep was too fast leaving later rounds feeling empty.

Consumables now can be stacked repeatedly.

Abilities now deal double damage against a target weakness (Halved for resist). 

Elemental potion: Increases base elemental damage and ability damage. (Up to 40%)

Resist potion: Increases base elemental resist and ability resistance. (Up to 40%)

Starters no longer gain 1 XP per round.

Arena mode 

Asynchronous multiplayer, allowing for endless play without matchmaking or timers.

Win 10 rounds before loosing 5 lifepoints.

View your next opponent allowing for strategic decision making. 

What's next?

Our priority will be releasing the rest of 121 index. (Updates to premade packs).

More items (Expanding the amount of items in each pack/build).

Custom games 

Ranked arena

Many bugs were fixed, too many to list here. 

Appreciate your patience, we are a very small team and aiming to deliver a much higher quality experience. 

Thank you for all for the ongoing support, and we hope to see you in the Arena!

notes.title: Patch notes build 0.1
notes.notes:
Patch notes for build 0.1  
[olist]
Matchmaking errors should be resolved. (Discuss below if you are still having issues).


Issues with players not being able to choose a pack and queue for matchmaking should be resolved.


Choosing a class now auto selects upon reaching 0. (Default is Sorcerer class).


Freezing empty shop slots is no longer possible. (Broke shop slot in management phase),


Settings button can no longer be used while in queue for matchmaking. 


Minor UI improvements.


Friend requests now prompt notifications.

Thank you all for your patience, we will have another patch Monday or Tuesday with core quality improvements to the game.

All the best 
- Dez


[/olist]

notes.title: Release date for FaeTerra!
notes.notes:
FaeTerra build 1.0 will be releasing on May 7th, we appreciate your patience! An incompetent former team member released the demo as the main game, so we temporarily removed FaeTerra from our Steam page. 

However despite many challenges we persevered and now arriving at our official release. May 7th @ 11am (CDT)

FaeTerra is heavily inspired by Super Auto Pets and Pokémon, with the fantastic game play and mechanics of SAP and the nostalgic essence of Pokémon, we aim to bring a new title to the creature collection and auto-battler genres.

I am super thrilled to have reached this milestone of releasing Solfiregames first title and hope to grow the FaeTerra IP. Thank you to my development team at Juesgo Studios for their brilliant engineering on this project.

All the best,
Dez
